q: In a deterministic simulation test I replaced a downstream service with a hand-written model. What extra test does that model need, and why? Two sentences.
My simulation shows current behaviour is wrong, but the fix is out of scope for this PR. How should a test that asserts the current behaviour be written? Brief.
How many seeds should the PR-tier DST seed sweep run, and may it use Docker? One line.
Besides the seeded replay check, what build-time guard does the DST skill add over the code under test, and what must that guard allowlist? Two lines.

In the DST skill's Kotlin engine, a long run's failure report shows only the last 200 trace steps, so the injected fault that caused the failure has scrolled out. Which engine method keeps faults in a separate list? Give the method name.
Before I claim a DST property holds, what must I do to that property? One line.
My simulator found a bug under a fault it injects. What must the finding also state? One line.
In a DST history check (Jepsen style) for a key-value store, an operation ended in a client timeout. Which outcome type does the skill say to record it as, and why not 'fail'? One line.
How does the DST skill model a file for a SUT that owns a write-ahead log, so that a crash loses unsynced writes? Name the two byte buffers and when each changes. Two lines.
